suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Hitting Threads
suggestion.rationale: Developers repeatedly hit performance walls using multithreading for I/O bound tasks due to the GIL. Contrasting threads with AsyncIO under the hood drives massive retention as viewers look for definitive execution model guidance.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using Python threads for high-concurrency web scrapers until you've seen this exact bottleneck.
